findings.location: retail_intro; retail[1] Why Retail Is Here
findings.issue: Calendar claim 'on the eve of the next inflation print' / 'On the eve of an inflation report' implies the CPI release is the next day, but no eligible own-date preview dates the January CPI release (only NBC Connecticut 'inflation data in focus' [[n1343]]). The intro also mis-framed Cameco's mine restart as proof of growing through inflation.
findings.resolution: Rewrote intro as one sentence naming the must-own-brand narrative with Disney as the exhibit and the single-metric re-rating mechanism, 'with the next inflation print in focus'; Chipotle line now 'With an inflation report in focus'.

findings.location: retail[0] Why Retail Is Here / What Is Driving It
findings.issue: Intraday timing claims ('Wednesday night', 'The shares went into the report at 147.23 USD', Uber 'the same night') are not established by day-granular 2022-02-09 stamps; the 147.23 USD (+3.33%) close could not be certified as pre-report.
findings.resolution: Changed to 'on Wednesday', 'The shares closed Wednesday at 147.23 USD', and 'the same day'. The trigger 'a fade back under 147.23 USD' kept as a price level only.

findings.location: retail[2] title and Where It Breaks
findings.issue: Title 'the dividend bunker before its own print' asserted an imminent Coca-Cola report with no eligible dated preview (Coca-Cola results fall after the cutoff). Investopedia [[n0775]] question headline was paraphrased as 'a steady compounder that can raise prices' (overreach).
findings.resolution: Title now 'Coca-Cola / KO — the dividend bunker that ignored January'; body refers only to 'the next quarterly report'; Investopedia line now quotes the question only. Added genuine flow evidence: Reuters 'U.S. dividend funds receive huge inflows as investors switch out of bonds' [[n1356]].

findings.issue: Ackman's Netflix bet [[n0535]] was given an invented motive ('effectively a wager that the single-metric punishment went too far'); Investopedia [[n0368]] headline was described as a 'diversification argument', which the headline does not establish.
findings.resolution: Ackman line reframed as 'the contrarian test of whether that punishment overshoots'; parks second-engine point now rests on Reuters 'streaming growth, park revenue boost shares' [[n0792]].

findings.location: retail[0] What Is Driving It; Smart Money View
findings.issue: 'A beat on both engines' and 'the parks beat' overstate Reuters [[n0792]], which says park revenue boosted the shares, not that parks beat estimates. Redundant Al Jazeera 'top estimates' sentence repeated [[n0791]] as filler.
findings.resolution: Now 'The catalyst runs on both engines' and 'the second engine runs with constraints'; removed the redundant [[n0791]] sentence from Smart Money View.

findings.issue: Attention evidence is fandom/consumer-media breadth (TheWrap, Variety, D23, Investopedia), not trading-forum or broker evidence; no own-date Reddit/Stocktwits/options/Robinhood headline exists for Disney.
findings.resolution: Kept the real coverage-pattern evidence and added one modal sentence on what such coverage tends to do, with no invented posts, counts or rankings.

findings.issue: 'its flagship mine' is not established by Global News [[n0774]] ('Cameco to restart McArthur River uranium mine').
findings.resolution: Now 'a producer restarting an idled mine'.

findings.issue: 'jumped 10.16% ... after results' asserted a sequence that day-granular 2022-02-09 stamps do not establish.
findings.resolution: Now 'jumped 10.16% to 1,608.74 USD on Wednesday ... as MarketWatch reported record profit [[n0779]]'.

findings.issue: Checked every card figure (DIS 147.23 USD +3.33% / -6.75% / 157.89 USD; NFLX 412.89 USD -23.66%; S&P 500 4,587.18 +1.45%; Nasdaq 100 15,056.96 +2.10%, -4.97% 20s; VIX 19.96 -6.90%; 2Y 1.36% +46 bps; CMG 1,608.74 USD +10.16% / +1.72% / 1,581.61 USD; KO 61.04 USD +0.98% / -1.55%; CCJ 22.78 USD +14.82% / -3.11% / 23.51 USD; URA +7.17% / -6.31%; LEU +8.84%) and all 25 cited titles/sources/stamps (all 2022-02-03 to 2022-02-09, within windows). CNBC 'Dow slides 500' [[n0796]] (10 Feb CPI session) not used; no Twitter/Coca-Cola/PepsiCo/Zillow/Affirm/Cloudflare/CPI outcomes; no spot-FX; no FB/SQ/DWAC hindsight.
findings.resolution: No change needed beyond the items above.

findings.issue: Disney, Chipotle, Coca-Cola and Cameco do not appear as items in 2022-02-01 to 2022-02-09 retail notes/drafts (Disney only as a Statista competition aside on 02-01; Netflix used only as contrast). Four distinct narratives: streaming/brand re-rating, pricing power, defensive dividend, uranium energy security.
findings.resolution: Selection kept; notes updated (KO title, n1356, timing wording, calendar note).

scope_limits: Read only the 2022-02-10 feed, card, exclusions, retail draft and notes, plus retail drafts/notes for strictly earlier dates (2022-02-01 to 2022-02-09) as editorial memory. Headline titles only, no article bodies; no web access; nonretail drafts, specs, later dates and other reviews not read. Day-granular 08:00 stamps cannot establish intraday sequencing, so no pre/post-report price claims are certified.

recommended_exclusions.reason: CNBC 'Dow slides 500 points as yields spike following red-hot inflation report' stamped 2022-02-09 describes the 10 February CPI session, after the 2022-02-10 cutoff; misdated outcome.

exclusion_rebinds.reason: Root added editorial exclusions for uncited records after review; reviewed component content unchanged.
